## Bring the work together

Complete a substantial project, service task, fabrication challenge, or investigation that requires planning, technical work, and evaluation.

## Show authentic evidence

A strong submission can combine the physical result, photographs, measurements, procedures, CAD or diagrams, teacher observation, oral explanation, and concise written reflection.
